questions.question:
Which two numbers (NOT digits) and two signs need to be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

35 ÷ 4 × 48 + 70 – 10 = 40
questions.solution:
Bodmas Table:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a3ba98fe537b71a0cedca8cdf679aea0668b950fa8b6ddc2ea6c6e99a6adff.png] 

**Given Equation :- 35 ÷ 4 × 48 + 70 – 10 = 40**

**Option(1) 35 and 48, – and ÷**

After Interchange:

⇒ 48 - 4 × 35 + **__70 ÷ 10__** = 40 

⇒ 48 - __**4 × 35**__ + 7 = 40

⇒ __**48**__ - 140 __**+ 7**__= 40

⇒ __**55 - 140**__ = 40

⇒ - 95 ≠ 40

questions.question:
If '+' means '×', '×' means '-', '-' means '+', and '÷' remains unchanged, then find the value of the following expression.

18 ÷ 6 + 12 × 2 - 5
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

**Given: 18 ÷ 6 + 12 × 2 - 5 = ?**

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 
 
 

 Means
 **×**
 **+**
 **-**
 **÷**
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ **__18 ÷ 6__** × 12 − 2 + 5 

= **__3 × 12__** − 2 + 5 

⇒ **__36 − 2__** + 5 

= __**34 + 5**__ = **39**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**

questions.question: Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R, and S are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center. S and O are not sitting next to each other. R sits to the immediate left of M. M sits second to the left of S. Q is sitting between N and O. N is a neighbor of S. Who is sitting to the immediate left of N?
questions.solution:
**Given: **Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R, and S are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center. 

1) R sits to the immediate left of M.

2) M sits second to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29e138ca5f5611d585a7072bd7ec3bfce1e5ffcbb945da44d8ed8139628d1441.png] 

3) N is a neighbor of S.

4) Q is sitting between N and O.

5) S and O are not sitting next to each other.

Thus, after positioning N, O, and Q only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe02ae618b62e32ae96b83859e04071e43d81dd5d24debbf3ae4855655f173f9.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement S is sitting to the immediate left of N.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

12 : 62 : 14 : _____
Four number-pairs have been given. Out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number-pair that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

The logic followed here is:

First number × ( First number+ 1) = second number

1) 11 : 142 → 11 × (11 + 1) = 132 ≠ 142

2) 22 : 506 → 22 × (22 + 1) = 506

3) 17 : 306 → 17 × (17 + 1) = 306

4) 14 : 210 → 14 × (14 + 1) = 210

Hence, ‘11 : 142’ is the odd one out.

**Direction: **Study the following arrangement carefully and answer the given question.

α A 7 J B C ¥ H 2 $ N E M 8 B ₤ 3 K I @ D U 4 9 % ^ T #

If all symbols are removed find the 8th element to the left of the 5th from the right end?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

**Given series:** α A 7 J B C ¥ H 2 $ N E M 8 B ₤ 3 K I @ D U 4 9 % ^ T #

By removing all the symbols we will get a new series as follows:

**New series:** A 7 J B C H 2 N E M 8 B 3 K I D U 4 9 T

If we have a combination of opposite directions like **left and right** or **right and left** then we take the sum of the numbers to find the final position.

Here, the 8th element to the left of the 5th from the right end is given 

Therefore, 8 + 5 = 13

Hence, the 13th element from the right end will be the answer to the given question.

A 7 J B C H 2 __**N**__ E M 8 B 3 K I D U 4 9 T

Hence, the correct answer is **N**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

The logic follows here is:

Given series: α A 7 J B C ¥ H 2 $ N E M 8 B ₤ 3 K I @ D U 4 9 % ^ T #

By removing all the symbols we will get a new series as follows:

New series: A 7 J B C H 2 N E M 8 B 3 K I D U 4 9 T

The 5th element from the right end is D

The 8th element to the left of D is N

A 7 J B C H 2 __N__ E M 8 B 3 K I D U 4 9 T

Hence, the correct answer is N.

questions.question: There are 6 contestants in a beauty pageant. Model Q is taller than model A but shorter than model E. Model X is not as tall as model E but is taller than model I. Model F is taller than model I but shorter than model Q. Who among the following is the tallest?
questions.solution:
**Given: **There are 6 contestants in a beauty pageant. 

1) Q is taller than model A but shorter than model E.

E > Q > A 

2) Model X is not as tall as model E but is taller than model I.

E > X > I

3) Model F is taller than model I but shorter than model Q.

Q > F > I

So, combining all we get:

Case 1) X Q > A /F > I 

Case 2) E > Q > A /F > I 

In both cases, E is the tallest among all.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.

2. No one has freedom and discipline in society. → Does not follow as it is not known how many people are lacking freedom and discipline.

**Hence, the correct answer is Only conclusion (1) follows.**
